profile_text.body:
Course Hero is an online learning platform founded in 2006 and headquartered in Redwood City. According to its website, the company offers instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep, 24/7 homework help, tutors, and related educational materials. The company describes its mission as helping students "own the study hour" and "get unstuck."

The company's AI product is QuillBot, a writing and editing tool focused on paraphrasing. Course Hero is operated as a business unit of Learneo, Inc.
